note: Known-class screening on NEU-DET. FAIL is the 10th percentile of the development scores; REVIEW is the highest lower threshold that keeps non-PASS recall at or above 95% with a review rate at or below 10%. Per-class report thresholds are calibrated on matched development boxes. The 10% development split is also used for early stopping, so the thresholds are development estimates; the source has no normal steel population, so no false-alarm claim is made.
